CustomField.description: The API name of the Salesforce object this field mapping belongs to, copied automatically from the parent Object Mapping record so it can be shown directly on Field Mapping list views and page layouts without navigating to the parent. Read-only; always reflects the current Object API Name on the related Object Mapping.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Salesforce object this field belongs to, copied from the parent Object Mapping (e.g. Account, Custom_Object__c).
CustomField.label: Object API Name
